proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING EMPLOYMENT DIVERSITY REPORT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a diversity report with employee gender and race data by EEO-1 job category, affirmative action summary, and diversity policies, available by September 2016.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal 5 – Special Shareowner Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws to give holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.
